facts.statement: The current Board has 10 directors; all 10 director nominees are incumbent directors.
All 10 directors serving at the 2021 annual meeting attended that meeting.
Stephen B. Burke is an incumbent director, serving since 2004.
Linda B. Bammann is an incumbent director, serving since 2013.
Todd A. Combs is an incumbent director, serving since 2016.
James S. Crown is an incumbent director, serving since 2004.
James Dimon is an incumbent director, serving since 2004.
Timothy P. Flynn is an incumbent director, serving since 2012.
Mellody Hobson is an incumbent director, serving since 2018.
Michael A. Neal is an incumbent director, serving since 2014.
Phebe N. Novakovic is an incumbent director, serving since 2020.

facts.statement: All directors of the Firm were elected by shareholders in 2021.

The Board determined nine non-management directors independent under NYSE and Firm standards, with only immaterial Firm relationships: Bammann, Burke, Combs, Crown, Flynn, Hobson, Neal, Novakovic and Rometty. CEO James Dimon is the exception.
James Dimon is Chairman since 2006 and CEO since 2005; the Board currently combines the Chair and CEO roles.

Stephen B. Burke has been Lead Independent Director since 2021. In March 2022 independent directors maintained the leadership structure with Burke in that role, considering his effective performance over the prior year.
Five independent principal standing committees: Audit; Compensation & Management Development (CMDC); Corporate Governance & Nominating (Governance); Public Responsibility (PRC); Risk.
Additional standing committees: Stock and Executive. Two current Specific Purpose Committees: Markets Compliance and Omnibus.
Audit: Timothy P. Flynn (Chair), Michael A. Neal and Phebe N. Novakovic.
CMDC: Stephen B. Burke (Chair), Linda B. Bammann, Todd A. Combs and Virginia M. Rometty.
Governance: Todd A. Combs (Chair), Stephen B. Burke and Virginia M. Rometty.
PRC: James S. Crown (Chair), Mellody Hobson and Michael A. Neal.
Risk: Linda B. Bammann (Chair), James S. Crown and Mellody Hobson.
The current membership table assigns Stephen B. Burke, Todd A. Combs, Mellody Hobson and Virginia M. Rometty to A; the 2021 footnote identifies A as Markets Compliance.
The current membership table assigns Linda B. Bammann, James S. Crown and Michael A. Neal to B; the 2021 footnote identifies B as Omnibus.
The CMDC report identifies independent directors Stephen B. Burke (Chair), Linda B. Bammann, Todd A. Combs and Virginia M. Rometty as its members.
The Audit report identifies Timothy P. Flynn (Chair), Michael A. Neal and Phebe N. Novakovic as its members.
Principal standing committee independence is 100%; the filing also states Board committees are chaired and constituted by independent directors.
All directors who served on Audit and CMDC were determined to meet additional NYSE independence and qualitative criteria applicable to those committees.
The Board determined each of the three Audit members had no material Firm relationship and was independent under Firm, NYSE and SEC audit-committee standards.

The filing assesses all nominees as possessing skills, experience, attributes and tenure for effective oversight, including independent perspective, integrity, judgment, work ethic, conviction, collaboration, inquisitiveness and willingness to challenge management.

Filing assessment of Stephen B. Burke: large/diverse business management; audit/financial reporting; risk; executive compensation; sales/marketing; technology/operations; regulated industries; international business.
Filing assessment of Linda B. Bammann: financial-services insight and wide-ranging experience; extensive risk-management and regulatory expertise.
Filing assessment of Todd A. Combs: financial markets, risk assessment and regulation; corporate governance, strategy, succession planning and compensation.
Filing assessment of James S. Crown: risk management, audit/financial reporting, investment management, capital markets and executive compensation.
Filing assessment of James Dimon: experienced financial-services leadership, international business, knowledge of all Firm activities and regulatory-process insight.
Filing assessment of Timothy P. Flynn: evolving business/regulatory environment, complex global companies, financial services, auditing and risk management.
Filing assessment of Mellody Hobson: financial services/markets, corporate governance, strategic planning, operations, regulation and international business.

Filing assessment of Michael A. Neal: complex global regulated businesses, financial services, risk, strategy/operations, finance/reporting, government/regulatory relations, management development and succession.
Filing assessment of Phebe N. Novakovic: international operations, leadership of a large complex organization, regulated industries and regulatory matters.
Filing assessment of Virginia M. Rometty: technology and complex global business leadership, succession, public-company governance, operational and regulatory issues.

The Board determined Timothy P. Flynn, Michael A. Neal and Phebe N. Novakovic, the Audit members in 2021, SEC-defined audit committee financial experts; the March 2022 Audit report also says each is financially literate.
facts.stated_time: 2021 Audit membership; 2022-03-14 report; determination date unspecified
